messages:
maria-ae: Hey team — FinCloud POC update. Dedicated pool and tenant (fincloud-poc-88) spun up but customer users can't SSO into the console or call the hosted API. They get a 401 from our AuthN service and SCIM provisioning returns 403 for group write. Also attempts to create a hosted API key in console are blocked with 'missing email claim'. Can someone triage?

sam-se: Thanks — can you paste the exact SAML assertion snippet or error the IdP shows (redact PII)? Often NameID format or `email` claim missing causes our key creation guardrails to block.

maria-ae: pasted redacted assertion below from Okta admin console:``` 
<saml:NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified">user123</saml:NameID>
<Attribute Name="email">
  <AttributeValue></AttributeValue>
</Attribute>
```
Customer insists they're sending an email attr but empty in our logs.

priyanka-devex: That NameID format (unspecified) is likely the issue for our console flow — we expect `emailAddress` or `persistent` mapped to `email` attribute. For SCIM 403, can you grab the SCIM request/response id from the customer or our logs (we log scim_request_id on failure)?

maria-ae: scim_request_id=scm_54f1a2a8, debug log snippet:``` 
{"status":403,"detail":"principal lacks permission to write groupMembership","tenant":"fincloud-poc-88","scim_request_id":"scm_54f1a2a8"}```

ola-support: On it. 403 usually means the user our SCIM connector uses isn't in the provisioning group allowed to modify membership on the Redwood side — I've seen Okta auto-provisioned service accounts sometimes not get the `admin` role mapping. Are they using delegated provisioning or a service app?

maria-ae: They're using an Okta SCIM app configured by customer's IT, not delegated. IT says provisioning logs in Okta show OK but SCIM calls to our endpoint show 403.

jordan-sre: Quick checklist: (1) Confirm IdP SAML attribute mapping for `email` and `groups` is set to send email as `urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3` or `email`. (2) Ensure the SCIM service account token in Okta matches the token we have on the tenant and hasn't been rotated. (3) Check that our tenant policy `allow_scim_group_writes` is enabled for this POC (we default to strict for hosted POCs).

maria-ae: how do I check the tenant policy? customer can't access console so they can't toggle.

kevin-ps: I can check from the private control plane. Holding: tenant_id=fincloud-poc-88, org_uuid=org_0a9b. Policy `allow_scim_group_writes` is currently false. I can flip it to true for a limited window if security approves. Should we?

priyanka-devex: Before toggling, let's be conservative. We should: (A) ask customer to map `email` attribute explicitly to the SAML assertion and set NameID to `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress` or include `email` attr; (B) confirm SCIM token in Okta matches token on tenant (we can reissue if needed); (C) temporarily enable `allow_scim_group_writes` for 24h while we complete onboarding.

maria-ae: I'm sharing mapping screenshots in the customer thread. They say Okta shows email populated, but ours shows empty. Might be a transformation rule stripping attrs.

idp-bot: Note: Observed 7 SAML assertions in last 10 minutes where `email` attribute missing. Source application: okta-fincloud-poc-app. Correlation id: cid-9b7f.

ola-support: Can you ask customer IT to toggle Okta app to send raw SAML assertion to a test endpoint (or provide an example) so we can compare? Also request the SCIM Authorization header to verify token.

maria-ae: asked them to give a sample assertion and SCIM request headers. They responded with Okta export: NameID set to `unspecified` and an Okta transformation that maps `email` but only for active users — the test user was invited but not activated.

sam-se: That would produce exactly the behavior: console creation guard rejects missing email, SCIM will create user but group writes fail if account isn't active or token mapping isn't correct. Next steps: have customer activate a test user, change NameID to emailAddress, or add explicit attribute mapping `email -> Email` in the app profile.

maria-ae: Customer activated the user and re-sent assertion. New snippet shows `NameID` formatted as email and `email` attribute present. Hosted API key creation still blocked with same error.

jordan-sre: Okay now check our auth service logs for the key creation attempt. ola-support, can you paste the request id?

ola-support: key_request_id=req_key_7c21. AuthN returned 422: `registration blocked: missing verified_email`. We require that SAML assertion contains `email_verified=true` or we accept a later verification step. Okta doesn't send `email_verified` by default.

kevin-ps: Two options: (1) We relax the guard to accept `email` without `email_verified` for POC tenants for 24h (low friction), or (2) have the customer add a transformation in Okta to add `email_verified=true` claim in SAML assertion. Security will prefer (2).

priyanka-devex: Security prefers (2) but we can offer (1) as a temporary workaround with explicit acceptance from our security team. I can get approval for a 24h relax if you want to unblock demos.

maria-ae: Customer needs to demo tomorrow. They asked for fastest path.

kevin-ps: I requested temporary exemption from security. Pending approval. Meanwhile advise customer to add the `email_verified` attribute in Okta (mapping stanza below):```
Attribute name: email_verified
Value: true
Include in assertion: Always
```

maria-ae: Telling them that and asking to confirm when done. Also asked them to re-run SCIM sync after activation.

ola-support: If exemption granted, I'll flip `allow_scim_group_writes` to true and note window. Also will reissue SCIM token if their token header doesn't match.

idp-bot: Security exemption request created: sec-req-331. Notified security-oncall.

priyanka-devex: Action items and owners: (1) maria-ae -> collect final assertion + SCIM headers from customer (due in 2h). (2) sam-se & ola-support -> validate token and scim_request_id logs (in 1h). (3) kevin-ps -> follow security exemption (ASAP). (4) priyanka-devex -> prepare rollback plan and temp policy flip checklist.

maria-ae: copied to customer with ETA. Will update here when they confirm. :thumbsup:
